scope: Independent source-photo and five-view appearance review, not a survey, engineering certification, slicer certification or actual-print test. Model not edited.
findings: The entire freestanding single-span gate is represented, not a cropped component or the Suzhou triple gate.

Two deep chamfered/faceted piers extend above the straight capped spandrel; one broad shallow arch retains long upright legs and curved shoulders. Approximate width/height and side depth are credible across front and oblique sources.
Front text reads 學 大 [seal] 吳 東 from viewer left to right, matching the source right-to-left school name. Noto Serif substitution is visible and disclosed, not claimed as Sun Ke calligraphy.
Central front beveled plaque and circular two-ring emblem are simplified but located correctly; fine seal lettering is intentionally omitted.

Rear spandrel has no replicated characters, seal or central plaque. Small rectangle visible above the cap in rear high-oblique view is the back edge of the FRONT-only plaque; top view and build coordinates confirm this.
Top and left-oblique views establish pier depth, thinner beam, faceted heads and genuine open passage. Exact cross-sections and top facet slopes remain photo-based estimates.
The low 194 x 40 x 3.5 mm joining platform is an explicitly invented printing/display plinth, not site geometry.
Five images include the complete model without clipping. No mandatory geometry revision found at the source-bound approximation scope.
required_release_disclosures: All dimensions, precise pier cross-section, cap facets, hidden joints and micro mouldings are estimated, not surveyed.
Noto Serif CJK TC Bold substitutes for the source calligraphy; two-ring seal is not a full emblem reproduction.
Printing platform is added, not a real gate footing or road survey.
2003-2019 dated photographs differ from capture-unknown rear contest photo; 2023 CDN path and 2024 PDF creation metadata are not camera capture dates. No 2026 survey/current-condition claim.
No actual-print or support-free certification; retain separate mesh/layer/thin-feature QA results and warnings.
limitations: Photographs contain perspective and sloping ground, so no exact dimensional tolerance is certified.
Aerial/top micro details are not directly surveyed.
This review does not replace mesh exchange, connectivity, slicing, minimum feature or printer-specific support checks.
